title: Ox Passion Blue Citrus Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Blue Citrus is an electrifying fusion of tart Blue Raspberry and vibrant citrus fruits. The deep, tangy-sweet intensity of blue raspberry is brightened by a lively burst of citrus, creating a bold and refreshing flavour with a crisp, zesty edge. The combination of berry richness and citrus sharpness makes for a dynamic vape with a balanced sweet-and-sour profile. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, providing a smooth throat hit and full-bodied flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it ensures rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
